title: MM6 Lich
description: MM6 skeletal lich: very thin ivory-bone skeleton, grinning skull with red eye sockets, tall spiked gold crown with red inset, dark gray-lavender segmented metal breastplate with red bat-shaped collar ornament, ragged ochre shoulder remnants and hanging waist strips, wide dark belt with red-orange oval buckle, silver-blue forearm guards and worn tall red-brown boots. Preserve bare thin bony upper arms and thighs, long delicate skeletal fingers, native gaunt silhouette and equipment proportions. No robes, staff, weapon, glowing aura or added accessories.
regions: Base forearm guards are silver-blue and collar ornament red. Bone, crown, gray torso armor, boots and belt remain protected.
